messages:
marta: handing off night oncall — quick rundown:
- current eu-west GPU pool utilization ~68% (avg tokens/s 22k).
- inference-queue length ~42 pending jobs, median tail latency 210ms.
- APAC customer batch window starts ~02:00 UTC, internal trend shows ~2x traffic for 2–3 hours.
- burst capacity = +8 GPUs available but account quota hard cap = 120 GPUs. if we hit quota we can't spin more — watch burst usage.
Runbook: https://go/runbooks/oncall-capacity (see section "burst + apac spikes").
Also: DO NOT merge or deploy PR #412 (model-scheduler prewarm) during the window — it changes prewarm behavior. leaving notes in handoff doc. i'll be reachable until 06:30 UTC.

alex: thanks, marta. i'll take 02:00–04:30 UTC. i'll monitor p95 and queue. can you paste the quick check commands?

sam: quick checks:
- live queue: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/queues/inference-queue | jq .length`
- gpu pool: `kubectl get deploy -n inference gpu-pool -o yaml | yq .status`
- prefix cache hit: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/cache/prefix?env=eu-west | jq .hit_rate`
- dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/capacity?range=1h

priya: deploy-bot just sent a heads-up: "Auto-scaler scheduled bump at 01:50 UTC per policy" — that should help pre-warm before the APAC window.

deploy-bot: Auto-scaler: scheduled scale-up at 01:50 UTC (+4 GPUs). See policy: team/auto-scaler/policies/apac-prewarm.

jamie: I can cover 04:30–06:30 UTC if someone needs to swap (have a lighter morning).

alex: @jamie great, can you also keep an eye on the billing/quotas page? if burst eats into reserved buckets we might hit the quota earlier. link: https://console.cloud/quotas/gpu

sam: quick note on mitigations if queue gets bad:
- temporarily increase batch size for non-interactive customers (router rule).
- enable degraded model variant for high-volume customers (fallback to quantized model).
- short-term throttle on non-critical bulk jobs (add header `x-rl: batch-low`).
If any of these happen, log the action in the #incidents channel with tag `non-incident-capacity` so SRE has context.

marta: thanks everyone. @sam i'll ping you if i need the swap earlier. @alex leave me a short note in the handoff doc about any throttles you apply.

alex: will do. also heads-up: PR #412 has one approval pending — @sam can you take a look after 01:00 UTC? it's touching prewarm timing only but i'd rather avoid surprises.

sam: yep i'll review after my current batch job finishes (~00:45 UTC). if it looks safe I'll approve but won't merge during the window.

marta: perfect. i'm signing off but staying watchable by DM. :thumbsup:
